description: This file defines a React component called StatusLogTab, which displays and manages the status logs associated with an asset. It includes functionality for listing, creating, editing, and updating status log entries, integrating with various API endpoints and rendering a data table with modals for input.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of asset status logs and updates the state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initial async function called within useEffect to load status logs and status code masters.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new status log entry and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with existing data for editing a selected status log entry and opens the modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates the form data and calls API endpoints to create or update a status log entry, then reloads data.
